name: Thailand
intro: Experience the Land of Smiles, a vibrant kingdom of gold-spired temples, tropical white-sand islands, and world-famous street food gastronomy.
bestSeason: November to February (Cool and dry season)
weather: Tropical monsoon climate. Highs of 32°C year-round. Monsoons run from June to October, dry cool air from November to February.
visaInfo: Visa exemption or Visa-on-arrival available for Indian citizens.
flightDuration: Approx 3.5-4 hours flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Marvel at the Grand Palace and Temple of the Emerald Buddha in Bangkok
Interact ethically with rescued giants at a Chiang Mai elephant sanctuary
Cruise by long-tail boat through the limestone cliffs of Phang Nga Bay
Relax on the turquoise beaches of Phuket and Koh Samui

famousPlaces.name: Bangkok Temples
famousPlaces.shortDesc: A bustling capital city famous for ornate shrines, active street life, and canal transport loops.
famousPlaces.overview: Bangkok is a vibrant assault on the senses. Gold-domed temples sit beside modern high-rises and busy canal waterways. Visitors can tour the sacred Grand Palace, take a river taxi, and dine at street food stalls.

hotels.name: The Siam Hotel Bangkok
hotels.description: Art-deco luxury hotel located on the Chao Phraya River with private pier.

famousPlaces.meals: Traditional breakfasts and private street-food market tours.
famousPlaces.transport: Skytrain passes and private river long-tail boats.
famousPlaces.activities: Grand Palace Tour, Wat Pho Reclining Buddha Visit, Chao Phraya Dinner Cruise.
included: Private boat charter for canal tour

faqs.q: What is the dress code for temples?
faqs.a: Shoulders and ankles must be covered. Slip-on shoes are recommended since you must remove them before entering temple buildings.

reviews.author: Rahul T.
reviews.text: The Grand Palace details are spectacular. The dinner cruise on the Chao Phraya river was very romantic.

itinerary.title: Arrival & River Sunset Cruise
itinerary.morning: Airport pickup and transfer to hotel. Rest.
itinerary.afternoon: Private long-tail boat ride through the quiet Thonburi canal loops.
itinerary.evening: Chao Phraya luxury dinner cruise seeing Wat Arun lit up at night.

itinerary.title: Grand Palace & Street Food Crawl
itinerary.morning: Guided walking tour of the majestic Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaew.
itinerary.afternoon: Visit Wat Pho to see the giant gold Reclining Buddha.
itinerary.evening: Street food crawl in Yaowarat Chinatown tasting local pad thai and mango sticky rice.
